diff_rdist_le_3.statement: Let $G$ be a finite abelian group which is a module over $\mathbb Z/2\mathbb Z$ (i.e. an elementary abelian $2$-group), equipped with a measurable structure in which singletons are measurable. Let $\Omega_{01},\Omega_{02}$ be measure spaces and let $p$ be a reference package for $G$ over them, with reference random variables $X^0_1$ on $\Omega_{01}$ and $X^0_2$ on $\Omega_{02}$ and parameter $\eta$. Let $\Omega$ be a probability space, and let $X_1, X_2, \tilde X_1, \tilde X_2 : \Omega \to G$ be random variables with $X_1$ and $\tilde X_2$ measurable, $\tilde X_2$ identically distributed with $X_2$, and $X_1, X_2, \tilde X_2, \tilde X_1$ jointly independent. Then $$d[X^0_1; X_1 \mid X_1 + \tilde X_2] - d[X^0_1;X_1] \le \tfrac12 d[X_1;X_2] + \tfrac14 H[X_1] - \tfrac14 H[X_2].$$

diff_rdist_le_4.statement: Let $G$ be a finite abelian group which is a module over $\mathbb Z/2\mathbb Z$ (i.e. an elementary abelian $2$-group), equipped with a measurable structure in which singletons are measurable. Let $\Omega_{01},\Omega_{02}$ be measure spaces and let $p$ be a reference package for $G$ over them, with reference random variables $X^0_1$ on $\Omega_{01}$ and $X^0_2$ on $\Omega_{02}$ and parameter $\eta$. Let $\Omega$ be a probability space, and let $X_1, X_2, \tilde X_1, \tilde X_2 : \Omega \to G$ be random variables with $X_2$ and $\tilde X_1$ measurable, $\tilde X_1$ identically distributed with $X_1$, and $X_1, X_2, \tilde X_2, \tilde X_1$ jointly independent. Then $$d[X^0_2; X_2 \mid X_2 + \tilde X_1] - d[X^0_2;X_2] \le \tfrac12 d[X_1;X_2] + \tfrac14 H[X_2] - \tfrac14 H[X_1].$$

rdist_add_rdist_add_condMutual_eq.statement: Let $G$ be a finite abelian group which is a module over $\mathbb Z/2\mathbb Z$ (i.e. an elementary abelian $2$-group), equipped with a measurable structure in which singletons are measurable. Let $\Omega$ be a probability space, and let $X_1, X_2, \tilde X_1, \tilde X_2 : \Omega \to G$ be measurable random variables with $\tilde X_1$ identically distributed with $X_1$, $\tilde X_2$ identically distributed with $X_2$, and $X_1, X_2, \tilde X_2, \tilde X_1$ jointly independent. Then $$d[X_1+\tilde X_2;\ X_2+\tilde X_1] + d[X_1\mid X_1+\tilde X_2;\ X_2 \mid X_2+\tilde X_1] + I[X_1+X_2 : \tilde X_1 + X_2 \mid X_1+X_2+\tilde X_1+\tilde X_2] = 2\,d[X_1;X_2].$$

rdist_of_sums_ge.statement: Let $G$ be a finite abelian group, equipped with a measurable structure in which singletons are measurable. Let $\Omega_{01},\Omega_{02}$ be measure spaces and let $p$ be a reference package for $G$ over them, with reference random variables $X^0_1$ on $\Omega_{01}$ and $X^0_2$ on $\Omega_{02}$ and parameter $\eta$. Let $\Omega$ be a probability space, let $X_1, X_2, \tilde X_1, \tilde X_2 : \Omega \to G$ be measurable, and suppose $(X_1,X_2)$ minimizes $\tau$ for $p$. Then $$d[X_1+\tilde X_2;\ X_2+\tilde X_1] \ge d[X_1;X_2] - \eta\big(d[X^0_1; X_1+\tilde X_2] - d[X^0_1;X_1]\big) - \eta\big(d[X^0_2;X_2+\tilde X_1] - d[X^0_2;X_2]\big).$$

first_estimate.statement: Let $G$ be a finite abelian group which is a module over $\mathbb Z/2\mathbb Z$ (i.e. an elementary abelian $2$-group), equipped with a measurable structure in which singletons are measurable. Let $\Omega_{01},\Omega_{02}$ be measure spaces and let $p$ be a reference package for $G$ over them, with reference random variables $X^0_1$ on $\Omega_{01}$ and $X^0_2$ on $\Omega_{02}$ and parameter $\eta$. Let $\Omega$ be a probability space, and let $X_1, X_2, \tilde X_1, \tilde X_2 : \Omega \to G$ be measurable random variables with $\tilde X_1$ identically distributed with $X_1$ and $\tilde X_2$ identically distributed with $X_2$, such that $X_1, X_2, \tilde X_2, \tilde X_1$ are jointly independent, and suppose $(X_1,X_2)$ minimizes $\tau$ for $p$. Write $k := d[X_1;X_2]$ and $I_1 := I[X_1+X_2 : \tilde X_1 + X_2 \mid X_1+X_2+\tilde X_1+\tilde X_2]$. Then $I_1 \le 2\eta k$.

ent_ofsum_le.statement: Let $G$ be a finite abelian group which is a module over $\mathbb Z/2\mathbb Z$ (i.e. an elementary abelian $2$-group), equipped with a measurable structure in which singletons are measurable. Let $\Omega_{01},\Omega_{02}$ be measure spaces and let $p$ be a reference package for $G$ over them, with reference random variables $X^0_1$ on $\Omega_{01}$ and $X^0_2$ on $\Omega_{02}$ and parameter $\eta$. Let $\Omega$ be a probability space, and let $X_1, X_2, \tilde X_1, \tilde X_2 : \Omega \to G$ be measurable random variables with $\tilde X_1$ identically distributed with $X_1$ and $\tilde X_2$ identically distributed with $X_2$, such that $X_1, X_2, \tilde X_2, \tilde X_1$ are jointly independent, and suppose $(X_1,X_2)$ minimizes $\tau$ for $p$. Write $k := d[X_1;X_2]$ and $I_1 := I[X_1+X_2 : \tilde X_1 + X_2 \mid X_1+X_2+\tilde X_1+\tilde X_2]$. Then $$H[X_1+X_2+\tilde X_1+\tilde X_2] \le \tfrac12 H[X_1] + \tfrac12 H[X_2] + (2+\eta)k - I_1.$$
